_comment: Verifiable facts about each community, so a post can say who developed it,
who designed the course and when it opened, rather than the interchangeable
luxury copy every competitor publishes. This is what makes Ricky read as the
expert on a specific place instead of a lender who mentions its name.
TWO KINDS OF DATA, DELIBERATELY SEPARATED:
1. `facts` are stable. A developer, an architect, an opening year and an
acreage do not change. Each carries a `sources` list, and nothing goes in
here without one. If it cannot be sourced it does not get written.
2. `market` is volatile and is NULL until real data is supplied. Average sale
price, last sale and days on market move every month. A stale number on a
licensed MLO's site is worse than no number, and an invented one is
indefensible. Never populate this from memory or estimation.
WHERE MARKET DATA MUST COME FROM: an MLS subdivision report pulled by a
licensed agent, or Maricopa County Assessor and Recorder public records.
Note that republishing MLS data on a public website carries IDX licensing
obligations from ARMLS. Confirm what Ricky's agreement permits before any
MLS-derived figure is published. County records are public and carry no
such restriction, which makes them the safer source for last-sale data.
Every published market figure must carry `asOf` and `source` in the post.

marketSchema.asOf: YYYY-MM-DD, the date the data was pulled. Required.
marketSchema.source: Named, citable. 'ARMLS subdivision report' or 'Maricopa County Recorder'. Required.

facts.setting: canyons of the McDowell Mountains, bordering the McDowell Sonoran Preserve

facts.golfCourse: The Country Club at DC Ranch
facts.history: Land claimed by E.O. Brown, who arrived from Wisconsin in 1901. Operated as a cattle ranch until the 1950s, at one point spanning 43,000 acres. Purchased by DMB in the 1990s.

facts.renovation: Major renovation led by Tom Weiskopf in 2007, which also reconfigured the 36 holes across both courses
facts.setting: Sonoran Desert in the shadow of Pinnacle Peak
facts.note: Troon North Golf Club and the private Troon Country Club are different entities. Do not conflate them.

facts.amenities: Pocket parks, city parks, playgrounds, picnic areas, greenbelts and the Grayhawk trail system

facts.courseNote: The largest collection of Jack Nicklaus Signature courses in the world
